purpose: Record six additional fully content-checked cross-window duplicate relationships and two pairs preserved as distinct.

findings.subject: Literature in English
findings.concept: Denouement/resolution is the concluding stage where the main conflict is resolved
findings.question_a: The denouement of a narrative is the stage at which:
options_a: conflicts are resolved and loose ends are brought together
the main characters are first introduced
the setting is described for the first time
the narrator changes from first person to third person
findings.question_b: The resolution of a narrative is the part in which:
options_b: The main conflict is brought to a conclusion or settled
The setting and main characters are first introduced
A new conflict is introduced without development
The author lists sources used in writing
findings.reason: Both rows are already recorded as held against batch 20 row 39 in DUP-21 and DUP-83. This candidate confirms another relationship in the same three-row cluster; no new replacement target is added.

findings.subject: Government
findings.concept: Proportional representation allocates seats broadly in proportion to votes received
findings.question_a: Proportional representation aims to allocate legislative seats broadly in proportion to the:
options_a: Number of judges in each region
findings.question_b: Under a proportional representation electoral system, legislative seats are allocated mainly according to:
options_b: the number of votes each party receives.
the age of each party's leader.
the number of local government areas in the country.
the order in which parties were registered.
findings.reason: Both assess the same defining principle of proportional representation and use the same correct answer.

findings.subject: Physics
findings.concept: Wavelength is the distance between successive points in the same phase
findings.question_a: The distance between two successive compressions in a longitudinal wave is called its:
findings.question_b: The wavelength of a wave is the distance between two successive points that are:
findings.reason: The longitudinal-wave wording gives a specific example of the same general wavelength definition; both assess the distance between successive points in the same phase.
